pairs.registryProposal: Pinning a regression baseline is its own small technique (pin a measurement, not a candidate): a baseline keyed by version only silently re-scores itself whenever the version gains ratings under a new suite or judge. comparison-modes says absolute on a frozen instrument but does not name the baseline-pin shape.
